research_question: What does this paper contribute to the verified evolution of Jim Fan's collaborative research program, and within what empirical boundary?
contributions: BadRobot demonstrates that embodied LLM systems can be jailbroken into unsafe actions and that two tested defenses only partially mitigate the attacks.

method.summary: No-box jailbreak prompts exploit conflicts between textual alignment and embodied action execution, followed by consistency and world-model defenses.
assumptions: Author order records collaboration but is not used to infer individual contribution.

study_context.sample_or_scale: Selected embodied LLM stacks, prompt attacks, simulator tasks, and two physical robot setups.

evaluation.design: CaP, ProgPrompt, VoxPoser and VisProg simulations plus UR3e/myCobot physical experiments and mitigation tests.

findings.finding: BadRobot demonstrates that embodied LLM systems can be jailbroken into unsafe actions and that two tested defenses only partially mitigate the attacks.
